Four halves requested by larpinq's merged change registration-payments-through-shillinq (larpinq PR #749): an event-fee requestType, matching a bank line to an object payment request by its reference, a receipt mail to the debtor on capture, and an invoice made when the debtor asks for one. Shillinq has none of them for a request on an object; larpinq's design D1 and D4 depend on them. Build: a merged change of another product depends on these halves.

Two halves requested by larpinq's merged change registration-cancel-transfer-refund (larpinq PR #749): receiving a refund or credit request for an object payment request, and applying a debtor's open credit to a later request. Nothing in shillinq receives either; case-payment-requests leaves refunds out and CreditNote reverses only invoices. Build: a merged change of another product depends on these halves.

Expense account half requested by humaniq's payroll-expenses-and-allowances (design D6: a journal debit line on the new setting getGlPostAccountReimbursements). The seeded charts already carry accounts that take it: the RGS MKB seed has 4060 Overige personeelskosten, 4500 Reiskosten and 4530 Kilometervergoeding, the BBV seed 7000 Personeelslasten (lib/Settings/seeds, shipped by 2026-06-14-add-shillinq-bookkeeping-foundation). Humaniq names the number in its own setting, as it does for the other four journal lines.

Journal-line cost codes half requested by humaniq's payroll-cost-allocation (design D4 writes costCenterCode and projectCode on the payroll journal's debit lines). JournalEntry.lines carries only account, side, amount and description, and ledger-posting-path maps only those onto GLLine, so the codes would be lost. Build: another product's merged change depends on it.
